newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific settles patent lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific settles patent lawsuit.

text.p: Union Pacific Resources Group Inc said Tuesday that it has settled a lawsuit with two former employees and the company they started, T&T Geotechnical Inc.
No monetary consideration was paid by either side in the settlement, Union Pacific said.
The company said the lawsuit alleged patent infringement and misappropriation of trade secrets by the former employees.
According to the company, the lawsuit covered its patented geosteering method and related proprietary computer software.
Geosteering technology steers a drill bit while a well is drilling to keep the wellbore in a desired geologic zone, the company said.
